description: The official in-fight log of one settled UFC bout (June 2013 onward): every logged action in order (round starts and ends, takedowns and attempts, knockdowns, submission attempts, reversals), the referee stoppages paired with their reason (eye poke, low blow, doctor check or other) and real length, and every confirmed foul of the bout. The log labels only eye pokes and low blows, so any other foul (an illegal knee to a grounded opponent, an upkick, a headbutt, a bite, a fence grab) is reported when the athletic commission's point deduction or the official result confirms it: each stoppage says whether it was a foul, which foul, which record confirms it (log, deduction or result), who committed it, the points deducted and whether the bout ended on it; a stoppage logged as "other" with no record behind it is never a foul. Stoppage reasons are logged from December 2018. A recorded foul is not a ruling on intent. Settled bouts only. Pro plans and up.

fight_id.description: Bout id, as returned on an event card. Integer or numeric string.
